_comment: Copy the blocks you need into ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (global) or .agents/hooks.json (workspace). Replace <you> with your user name and write full absolute paths. Antigravity's hooks.json is a map of NAMED hook groups, unlike Claude Code's single hooks object.
_comment_no_quotes: Do NOT wrap the script path in quotes. Antigravity splits a hook command into argv itself instead of handing it to a shell, so the quote characters stay in the filename and Python fails with [Errno 22] Invalid argument. Claude Code does run hook commands through a shell, where the quoted form is correct -- so this is one line you must not copy between the two editions. Because there is no shell to strip quotes, a path containing spaces cannot be expressed here: keep hook scripts on a space-free path.
_comment_windows: Use python, not a bare `bash`: on Windows a hook command starting with `bash` resolves to C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe (WSL), whose home directory differs, so ~/.gemini/... does not exist there and the hook silently never runs.
_comment_route_guard: route-guard reuses claude/templates/route-guard.py unchanged. Copy it to ~/.gemini/config/hooks/route_guard.py; --agent antigravity makes every allow answer {"decision": "ask"}.
